verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Weave's SDK is published in a public GitHub repository (github.com/wandb/weave), whose README covers tracing, evaluations and agent instrumentation, so users can read the source. Nothing in the pack names the repository's license, so 'under an open license' is unconfirmed. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence (e.g. Apache/MIT LICENSE file), confirmation that the server/UI source (not just the SDK) is open, independent corroboration.
